content: During this evaluation, we followed the same preprocessing methods we used during training. Then, we auto segment the transcript into small contiguous segments similar to the grounded sentences in the annotations for tags extraction. To segment the transcript, we follow a simple procedure. First, we detected all the medications in a transcript using RxNorm BIBREF20 via string matching. For all the detected medications, we selected $2 \le x \le 5$ nearby sentences as the input to our model. We increased $x$ iteratively until we encountered a quantity entity – detected using spaCy's entity recognizer, and we set $x$ as 2 if we did not detect any entities in the range.
